idpho.2020.1.1.printed_source_pages: Theory, English (Official), pages Q1-1 to Q1-2
idpho.2020.1.1.source_format: Official IPhO examination paper (English), as distributed by the organisers
idpho.2020.1.1.source_variant_note: IdPhO 2020 (International distanced Physics Olympiad, online, Lithuania, December 2020), held in place of the cancelled IPhO 2020; official English paper, mirrored by olimpicos.net as IPhO_2020_Q1. Typed from the page images (no LaTeX draft). Wording as printed (e.g. “a weight is suspended to its lowest point”). The figures carry no captions.

idpho.2020.1.2.printed_source_pages: Theory, English (Official), pages Q2-1 to Q2-2
idpho.2020.1.2.source_format: Official IPhO examination paper (English), as distributed by the organisers
idpho.2020.1.2.source_variant_note: IdPhO 2020 (International distanced Physics Olympiad, online, Lithuania, December 2020), held in place of the cancelled IPhO 2020; official English paper, mirrored by olimpicos.net as IPhO_2020_Q2. Typed from the page images (no LaTeX draft). Decimal numbers as printed: decimal commas in the formulas (0,75; 0,5; 0,25; 9,8; 0,4; 0,7) but decimal points in 0.48, 0.34, 1.2 and 1.0 m/s. The word “primary” is italic in the paper. Wording as printed (e.g. “for the absolute value of the power of the friction force be at maximum”).

idpho.2020.1.3.printed_source_pages: Theory, English (Official), pages Q3-1 to Q3-4
idpho.2020.1.3.source_format: Official IPhO examination paper (English), as distributed by the organisers
idpho.2020.1.3.source_variant_note: IdPhO 2020 (International distanced Physics Olympiad, online, Lithuania, December 2020), held in place of the cancelled IPhO 2020; official English paper, mirrored by olimpicos.net as IPhO_2020_Q3. Typed from the page images (no LaTeX draft). Parts A, B and C carry no points in their headings (the points are given per question). In B.2 the answer is asked in terms of $E_m$ although the given datum is the intensity $I_0$, as printed. The paper writes “330,000” with a thousands comma and “--” before “exoplanets”. The figure in Part B has no caption (it is referred to as “the Figure”).
